notes: ACCESS: opened only via Claude-in-Chrome connector, own tab. robots.txt checked first: no ClaudeBot/Claude-User/Claude-Web/Claude-SearchBot/anthropic-ai disallow, only Pinterest crawl-delays and account/cart/checkout/_next-static blocks -- clear to proceed. Site loaded 200 on every route, no WAF/challenge. LOCALE: Canada roster -> used /ca/en/ storefront throughout, every link below is /ca/en/. TREE SOURCE: EQ3's furniture is NOT under one 'Furniture' department -- it is scattered across four room departments in the mega-menu (Living, Dining, Bedroom, Office), each expanded live (button click, not just static DOM) to reveal the full flyout tree; the site's own sitemap.xml (192 category URLs, fetched same-origin) was then cross-checked per Trap 1 and it surfaced one extra real node the mega-menu never rendered: Living > Media & Storage > Sideboards & Credenzas (dedup note below). PLATFORM/COUNT METHOD: Next.js SSR; same-origin fetch() of each category page's HTML in-tab, parsing the embedded __NEXT_DATA__ dehydrated react-query cache for the '/product-instance/search' query -> pages[0].data.count. This is the exact method and field the prior Home-Decor pass for this company validated as exact (25/25 nodes exhaustion-verified, matches api count). Spot-checked here against a known prior value (accessories/lighting/pendant-lamps) and reproduced count=75 exactly, confirming the method still works. OUTDOOR EXCLUDED, CONFIRMED RETIRED: sitemap.xml lists a full /category/outdoor/furniture/* tree (tables, outdoor-side-tables, outdoor-coffee-tables, outdoor-ottomans, outdoor-chairs, outdoor-sofas, cape-collection) and eq3plus/loll-designs + eq3plus/neighbor outdoor-branded nodes, but EVERY one of these live-fetched to an identical count=1064 (generic nodes) or count=205 (eq3plus nodes) with product samples completely unrelated to outdoor furniture (e.g. 'Kendall Desk', 'Silk & Snow Mattress') -- classic stale-sitemap fallback to a department/site-wide search, not a real listing. This matches the prior Home-Decor pass's independent finding that Outdoor is retired on this storefront. No outdoor rows emitted. TWO NODE-IDENTITY JUDGEMENT CALLS: (1) Dining > Storage > Sideboards & Credenzas and Living > Media & Storage > Sideboards & Credenzas resolve to the literal same subcategoryId ('12') and the identical 11 product IDs -- a true alias of one node reachable from two menu paths, not two different listings. Recorded once, under Dining > Storage (dining storage is the more natural home for sideboards/credenzas); the Living > Media & Storage grouping keeps only its two genuinely distinct children (Media Units, Bookshelves & Bookcases). (2) Living > Entryway > Tables (4 products, all console tables) is a strict subset of Living > Accent Tables > Console Tables (5 products) but has a DIFFERENT subcategoryId and is a genuine separate site nav node (room-curated merchandising, not a filter) -- kept as its own row since it is a distinct, separately-linked department page a shopper actually encounters; flagged here rather than silently merged. EXCLUSIONS applied (titles actually inspected): Living > Seating > 'Ready to Ship' (29 products, sample titles show it is a cross-cutting stock-availability filter spanning ottomans/sectionals/sofas already counted elsewhere, not a product type) -- dropped per section 3. Living > Entryway > 'Shelves & Hooks' (3 products: 'Harvest Art Ledges' = wall decor ledge, 'Duo Shelf' = storage roll-up, 'Orb Wood Knob' = hardware) -- none are furniture, node dropped entirely. Bedroom > Beds > Mattresses and > Slats -- bedding/hardware, excluded per brief; Bedroom > Bedroom Accessories (Blankets & Throws, Duvet Cover Sets, Pillows, Sheets, Shams, Bed Frame Covers) -- all textiles, excluded. Office > Desk Accessories and its sub-slugs (office-accessories, organization, monitor-arms, keyboard-trays) -- all four sub-slugs are ALSO a stale-sitemap fallback (identical count=4, identical sample names 'Ergonomic Headrest'/'Verve Headrest'/'Branch Adjustable Footrest' on every one), and even the true parent-level 4 products are ergonomic accessories, not furniture -- excluded. Accessories department (Rugs, Lighting, Accents, Dining/tableware, Barware) walked in full via its own flyout -- confirmed zero furniture-typed nodes, all decor/textile/tableware/lighting, out of scope for this task. Brands ('eq3plus/...' Humanscale, Herman Miller, Pablo Designs, Neighbor, Loll Designs, Silk & Snow, Marimekko, More Brands) -- brand/designer shop-in-shop listing pages, never extracted as categories per section 3, even where they duplicate furniture already captured under the room departments. SANITY CHECKS: every count re-fetched fresh (not cached from mega-menu numbers); none are round/suspicious (1000/5000); none matched a sitewide or department-wide total except the outdoor/desk-accessories fallbacks already identified and excluded; product-name samples were pulled and manually inspected for every ambiguous or small-count node (shelves-hooks, entryway tables/benches, bar-counter-tables, sideboards) to confirm they were not silently serving a wrong parent.
